title: Mark Read Removes Button and Dot
description: Clicking "Mark read" on one notification should immediately clean up everything about that item that says "unread" — the dot next to its title and its own "Mark read" link, both gone at once, without needing the dropdown to be reopened.
successCondition: Clicking "Mark read" on an unread notification inside the open dropdown results in, without closing and reopening the dropdown: that item's unread dot marker disappearing, that item's own "Mark read" link disappearing (since it's no longer applicable), and the header's unread count badge decrementing by exactly one — all reflected from the same reload() call, in one UI update.
hints: onMarkRead awaits the API call and then calls reload() — the update should be visible without any manual page refresh.
If there was only one unread notification before the click, the count badge should disappear entirely afterward, not show "0 unread".
